verdict.rationale: Productboard exposes a REST API with pagination, webhooks, and dynamic schema discovery, and an official MCP server enabling agents to automate workflows (add features, update drivers, reschedule initiatives) — supporting headless/CI-style automation. However, there is no evidence of a CLI, SDK, or dedicated CI/pipeline tooling, and OpenAPI spec endpoints returned 404s, suggesting automation is API/agent-driven rather than a first-class CI-native experience.
